classification.difficultyReason: Combine supplementary opposite angles with the angle in a semicircle and the triangle angle sum.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: An unshaded cyclic quadrilateral with a diameter from the lower-left vertex to the upper-right vertex through centre O, and a diagonal from the lower-left vertex to the lower-right vertex. Internal construction point names are not printed.
spec.mathematics: AB is a diameter through O. A, B, C and D lie on the circle in cyclic order. The interior angle ADC is 130 degrees. The unknown y is angle BAC.
spec.answerVisibility: Only O, y and the given 130-degree angle appear in the question diagram; the supplied 40-degree answer is omitted.

answer.worked:
The angle opposite $130^\circ$ is $180^\circ-130^\circ=50^\circ$ because opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary.

The angle at the lower-right vertex in the triangle containing the diameter is $90^\circ$ because it is an angle in a semicircle.

$$\begin{align*}y+50^\circ+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=40^\circ\end{align*}$$
